title: High blood pressure at home: what to do
also: high blood pressure what to do
what: A guide on how to measure your blood pressure correctly and what to do if it suddenly goes up.
why: For everyone who sometimes has high blood pressure, and their families.
duration: measuring takes 5 to 10 minutes, getting better usually takes up to an hour
tell_doctor: How often your blood pressure spikes
Which blood pressure medicines you take and when
Whether you have a medicine for a spike - your doctor must prescribe it
If your blood pressure goes up after certain medicines or events

prepare.title: Monitor
prepare.text: Keep a working blood pressure monitor at home. The cuff must fit the size of your arm.

prepare.title: Plan
prepare.text: Ask your doctor what to take during a spike and at what numbers to call.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: Write down your blood pressure in the morning and evening.

steps: Sit down, lean back, feet on the floor, and rest for 5 minutes
Put the cuff on your bare arm at heart level
If the pressure is high, take the medicine your doctor prescribed for this
Do not take several pills at once - lowering pressure too fast is dangerous
After 30 to 60 minutes, measure again and write it down
feel: You may have a headache, ringing in the ears or spots before your eyes
Worry raises blood pressure - try to breathe calmly
after: Show your blood pressure diary to your doctor
Do not skip your regular medicines
Less salt and more movement - as your doctor advises
red_flags: Chest pain or shortness of breath - call your local emergency number
Weakness or numbness in an arm, leg or half of the face, or trouble speaking - call your local emergency number
A very severe headache, loss of vision or confusion - call your local emergency number
Very high numbers, for example above 180/110, that do not come down - call your doctor or your local emergency number

faq.q: Can I take my neighbor's pill?
faq.a: No. Take only what your own doctor prescribed.

faq.q: Why is my blood pressure different in the two arms?
faq.a: A small difference is common. Measure on the arm where it is higher, and tell your doctor if the difference is large.

reminders.text: Time to measure your blood pressure: sit for 5 minutes, then take two readings.
